title: chore(small): feat: Treat any WebSocket message as a heartbeat
body:

This change prevents the server from prematurely disconnecting active clients by treating any incoming WebSocket message as a heartbeat. body:
## Description

This pull request details the investigation into an unexpected VRT snapshot regression identified in PR #3724. The task aimed to identify and resolve the root cause of this regression.

Initial attempts involved hiding the `Connect` component during VRTs, which resolved the original VRT failure but introduced new failures in the bluetooth-flow tests. A subsequent, more targeted approach to hide only the `HrmConnectionPanel` component yielded the same result of new bluetooth-flow test failures.

Despite various efforts, a solution that resolves the VRT failure without introducing new test failures could not be found. As such, this PR includes the reversion of all attempted fixes, returning the codebase to its original state as it was prior to the investigation.
